final: WITH circuit_races AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) as race_count, AVG(round) as avg_round FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), total_races AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM races) SELECT cr.circuitId, cr.avg_round, cr.race_count, ROUND(CAST(cr.race_count AS FLOAT) / tr.total, 4) as share FROM circuit_races cr CROSS JOIN total_races tr ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
